Lia: Morning team :wave: quick end-of-week sync — week 2 of onboarding. What I did: 1) Finished local dev env + sample app run, 2) Ran runtime unit tests (all green), 3) Opened PR for example inference pipeline (WIP).

Lia: Blockers: 1) can't push to infra repo (403), 2) VPN drops intermittently while running tests, 3) docker image failing on cudnn mismatch when starting GPU container.

Priya: Nice progress! I'll coordinate infra access. Can you paste the exact git error?

Lia: ```
git push origin feature/onboard
remote: Permission to redwood-inference/infra.git denied to lia.
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
```

Sam: @Lia can you also paste the `ssh -T git@github.com` result? If it's `Permission denied (publickey)` then the key isn't attached to your org account.

Lia: `ssh -T git@github.com` -> Permission denied (publickey). I added the key to my GitHub account yesterday though.

Sam: Ok — can you run `ssh-keygen -lf ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub` and paste the fingerprint? I'll check org SSO and repo ACLs.

Lia: fingerprint: `SHA256:AbCd1234efGH5678ijkl9MnOpQrStUvWxYz` (sent via DM to Sam)

Carlos: I can add a temporary collaborator on infra if Sam confirms. Send PR link and I'll grant repo access for 24h.

Lia: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/42

Sam: Escalated to SSO team — should have a fix in ~1-2 hours. For VPN: try switching to the corp-wifi profile or run `openvpn --ping 20 --ping-restart 60` to reduce drops.

Lia: Thanks — trying that now. Quick note about the docker cudnn error, paste log:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:34Z runtime ERROR: cuDNN version mismatch: expected 8600, found 8500
Aborting container startup.
```

Carlos: That's a host image mismatch — use `redwood/base-gpu:2026-03-10` for testing; dev infra will add broader compat matrix.

Priya: Schedule: 3pm 1:1 with Lia to review PR + onboarding checklist — I'll send calendar invite.

InfraBot: deploy-bot: Created ticket INFRA-5783 for GitHub org ACL investigation.

Lia: Appreciated, thank you everyone! Today's focus: resolve infra access, finish PR comments, and validate container with `redwood/base-gpu:2026-03-10`. :thumbsup:
